ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 40% high-intensity white pixel coverage concentrated in the distal regions and 60% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the medial and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white mottling and stippled focal spots distributed across the upper lateral regions of both lobes; solid black pigmentation occupies the central fluke body and the immediate area surrounding the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 35-45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations creating an irregular sawtooth profile along the continuous trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge leading to sharply tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark, circular pixel clusters embedded within the high-intensity white pigmentation zones on the outer halves of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the lower-left ventral surface, oriented diagonally toward the fluke tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregular, dark-colored patch with distinct texture variations is visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, suggesting significant localized trauma or tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'salt-and-pepper' stippling pattern where individual white pixels are densely interspersed with black pixels along the boundary between the white distal regions and black medial region.
